name: Mixture of Agents
description: Registers a mixture_of_agents tool that queries multiple provider models in parallel and aggregates their answers.

referenceModels.description: List of 'provider/model' pairs for reference queries

aggregatorModel.description: Model ID for aggregating reference answers

aggregatorProvider.description: Provider ID for the aggregator model

referenceTimeoutMs.description: Timeout ms for each reference model call (default: 60000)
